subject: Pilot billing: request for extended terms and EU VAT handling
messages:
From: Jane Palmer <jane.palmer@medicore.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicore Finance <finance@medicore.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Pilot billing & VAT handling — request for Net60 and credit line

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Were ready to move the 3-month pilot forward but need to settle commercial terms before we issue a PO. Two asks from our finance team:

1) Can Redwood accept Net60 for pilot invoices? Our AP cadence is constrained this quarter and Net60 would align to our treasury plan.
2) For the EU portion of usage, we need invoices without VAT (reverse-charge) and a split by legal entity (Medicore Ireland vs Medicore Germany) so our tax team can reconcile.

We expect monthly consumption ~45-60k EUR. As a courtesy wed like to request a provisional credit cap of 150,000 EUR while we ramp. If you need any paperwork, Ive attached a statement of account for context.

Can you confirm options and whats realistic on Redwoods side?

Thanks,
Jane Palmer
VP Finance, Medicore Health
Attachments: SOA_Medicore_Jun-Jul2026.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jane Palmer <jane.palmer@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Pilot billing & VAT handling — request for Net60 and credit line

Hi Jane,

Appreciate the clarity and the SOA. Short answer: we can get close but need a small compromise for pilot/capital exposure reasons. Proposed structure: 

- Standard term: Net45 (we can accept Net45 on production agreements).
- Pilot compromise: 25% retainer due up front, then Net45 on subsequent monthly invoices.
- Partial-sweep option: weekly auto-sweep of outstanding balances when outstanding > 30k EUR (reduces credit exposure).
- Credit cap: provisional review for a 150k EUR cap; final approval required by Redwood Finance (well aim for decision within 5 business days).
- VAT / invoicing: we can issue entity-specific invoices (Redwood EU SARL for EU usage) with the reverse-charge note; well need your VAT IDs and legal entity billing contacts.

Im attaching our temporary credit request form so you can provide the PO/credit references that finance needs. If youre comfortable, we can also agree to a short-term contract addendum capturing the retainer + sweep mechanics so both teams are aligned.

If that sounds reasonable Ill loop in finance and legal to start the paperwork.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_temp_credit_form.xlsx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:12:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: Pilot billing & VAT handling — request for Net60 and credit line

Laura / Marissa,

Forwarding Medicores request. Key asks: Net60, split EU invoices, provisional 150k cap. I proposed 25% retainer + Net45 and a weekly sweep threshold to mitigate exposure.

Action items for finance: please review the attached credit form and indicate if 150k provisional cap is acceptable for a new mid-market customer with a 3-month pilot. If underwriting wants different collateral (escrow, ACH guardrail), call it out. 

Action items for legal: if agreed, well need a one-page addendum capturing: (i) retainer amount and application to first invoice, (ii) automatic sweep process (merchant mandate), and (iii) invoicing entity split + reverse-charge language.

Im happy to join a quick 30-min sync.

Thanks,
Rishi
From: Jane Palmer <jane.palmer@medicore.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Medicore Finance <finance@medicore.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 13:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Pilot billing & VAT handling — request for Net60 and credit line

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — thats helpful and closer to what we can agree to. A couple follow-ups before Im able to sign off: 

- The retainer is OK if its applied to month 1 and visible on our PO. Please list it as "Pilot retainer (deductible from Invoice #1)".
- Weekly auto-sweep is acceptable, but we need a minimum 7-day notice before the first sweep and the ability to reject a single sweep in writing for confirmed disputed items.
- VAT: we will provide VAT IDs; Medicore Ireland should be billed for Ireland usage and Medicore Germany for German usage. Please include the standard EU reverse-charge statement on those invoices.
- Can you send the vendor onboarding form (for our AP) and a DocuSign-ready one-page addendum we can route internally?

Ive attached our vendor onboarding form and PO placeholders. If you can return the credit form and a one-page addendum Ill route for internal approvals.

Best,
Jane
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jane Palmer <jane.palmer@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Medicore Finance <finance@medicore.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Pilot billing & VAT handling — request for Net60 and credit line

Jane,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and very reasonable asks. Summary and confirmation below: 

- Terms: Pilot governed by a 3-month SOW addendum: 25% retainer (applied to Invoice #1) + Net45 for subsequent invoices.
- Sweep mechanics: weekly auto-sweep when outstanding balance > 30k EUR; Redwood will provide the first-sweep notice 7 days in advance; Medicore may reject one sweep per billing period by written notice citing a dispute.
- Credit cap: provisional 150k EUR cap submitted to Redwood Finance; we aim to confirm or propose alternate collateral by 2026-08-27.
- Invoicing / VAT: Redwood will split invoices by Medicore legal entity per usage reports. EU invoices will include the reverse-charge statement; please send VAT IDs and billing contacts to finance@redwood.com.
- Next steps: Ill attach the one-page addendum (DocuSign-ready) and our completed credit request back to you by EOD. If all looks good you can route the PO and onboarding form and well kick off provisioning.

Thanks — Ill loop finance and legal and send the paperwork shortly.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
